title: SNAP Login Screen
description:
As a registered user, log in with email and password to reach the SNAP account.
Background: the user is on the "Login to SNAPS" page.

Scenario: Successful login with valid credentials
Expected: Authenticated and redirected to the SNAP dashboard / home page

Scenario: Empty email field
Expected: Login button stays disabled or inactive

Scenario: Empty password field
Expected: Login button stays disabled or inactive

Scenario: Invalid email format
Expected: Inline validation error; user stays on the login page

Scenario: Unregistered email, or valid email with the wrong password
Expected: Invalid-credentials error; user stays on the page; password field is cleared

Scenario: Show / Hide on the password field
Expected: Plain text, then masked again

Scenario: Forgot Password?
Expected: Redirect to the password recovery page

Scenario: Either required field empty
Expected: Login button stays disabled or inactive
iteration: Ecom MVP\Ecom phase 2.1 release\Story Guard - AI Agent

scenarios.text: Successful login with valid credentials. Authenticated and redirected to the SNAP dashboard / home page
Empty email field. Login button stays disabled or inactive
Empty password field. Login button stays disabled or inactive
Invalid email format. Inline validation error; user stays on the login page
Unregistered email, or valid email with the wrong password. Invalid-credentials error; user stays on the page; password field is cleared
Show / Hide on the password field. Plain text, then masked again
Forgot Password?. Redirect to the password recovery page
Either required field empty. Login button stays disabled or inactive

note: AC-2, AC-3, and AC-8 say the Login button stays disabled when a required field is empty. Tests 121217, 121218, and 121219 say the tester clicks Login and sees inline validation. This note records that contradiction. It is not a mapping.
